WITH event_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL) AS ratio
  FROM event e
  INNER JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND e.location != ''
),
event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM event_ratios
  GROUP BY event_id, location
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC) AS rank
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank
